llm.notes: M.G.L. c. 186, § 31 requires a notice to quit for nonpayment of rent to come with an informational form (rental assistance, court rules, eviction restrictions, plus a required statement). It also bars courts from accepting summary process filings without proof that the form was delivered. This is a procedure for giving notice. It does not limit the reasons a landlord may use to end or not renew a tenancy. It also does not cover rent increases, security deposits, application fees, tenant screening, or algorithmic rent setting. So no rule in the defined categories was recorded.
